config.notes: T5 single-sample learnability control after 100-record overfit failed to localize even at 600 steps. Exactly one synthetic_train record (limit=1), same fixed LoRA/lr/batch/384/bf16/frozen-vision/seed/EOS/pad contract; num_epochs=1600 -> 1600 micro-batches = 200 optimizer steps; save_every=100; probe n=1 max_new_tokens=64. Independent run/output/log/results; no existing config/adapter/results modified. Goal: test whether a single sample can be overfit (clear loss drop, fully parseable probe, position close to GT). If it still cannot localize, stop GPU and audit vision-feature injection / pixel_attention_mask / pixel_values / loss path instead of blindly running full SFT.

evidence.conclusion: 128002 is only the Idefics3Config class-level default for top-level pad_token_id; the tokenizer, generation_config and text config all resolve to pad=2 / eos=49279. SFT explicitly appends eos=49279 to every answer and uses pad=2 for collation, so the warning is documented and does not affect the training contract.
